__note: Permanent time and view controls. Hearthblock icons (assets/ui/icons, doc 259) on the system family tile; labels appear on hover/focus. key_action names the input action whose key the hover card shows (doc 260). A view's view_name and view_line are its banner at the top centre while it is on (doc 23, "Views"): what it is and what it shows.

appeal.__note: The Appeal view (doc 23), read by AppealViewController: how much colour the dimmed world keeps and how bright it stays, how strongly a room's word tints its floor (the tints themselves are the words' in data/rooms/appeal.json), the glow on pieces that add appeal and on loose or stocked goods, and how often (real seconds) it redraws while on.

temperature.__note: The Temperature view (doc 23), read by TemperatureViewController: the dim as the Appeal view's, how strongly each word's colour tints a floor, and the colours themselves (the words' edges are temperature.json's). Floors are built in 16-column tiles within range_tiles of the point the camera looks at (checked every range_seconds), spending at most budget_ms a frame; changes gather for settle_seconds before tiles are built again, and the hover card is worked out every hover_seconds (real seconds).

pause.label: Pause / resume
pause.tooltip: Pause the settlement, or resume at the previous speed.

play.label: Normal speed · 1×
play.tooltip: Resume the settlement at normal speed.

fast.label: Fast speed · 2×
fast.tooltip: Resume the settlement at twice normal speed.

slice.label: Slice view
slice.tooltip: Cut the world away above a level. Your previous level is remembered. Scroll over the height tower for one level; Ctrl + scroll for four.

appeal.label: Appeal
appeal.tooltip: See how your dwarves find each room. The world dims and each sealed room's floor shows its appeal: Horrid, Plain, Pleasant or Beautiful. Hover a room for its parts; click it for the room.
appeal.view_line: How each room feels to the dwarves

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.tooltip: See how warm each place is now: Frozen, Cold, Chilly, Comfortable or Hot. Higher ground is colder, rock keeps out the day and most of the season, and fires warm sealed rooms. Hover a spot for what sets it; click a room for the room.
temperature.view_line: How warm each place is now

xray.label: X-ray
xray.tooltip: See dug rooms through the mountain. While it is on, choose Full or Flat and the lower-level guide.
xray.view_line: Dug rooms seen through the mountain
